intro: Guile of the Raptor is a quest in which Tor'gan seeks to awaken the dormant warrior spirit within Gor'mul. By harvesting the hearts of Highland Fleshstalkers, Tor'gan plans to fashion an enchanted item imbued with the cunning and predatory power of the raptor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant!
I will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
